verdict.rationale: Zapier documents its own in-product AI: Zapier Agents built with Zapier Copilot that perform tasks across 9,000+ apps, plus AI-generated troubleshooting instructions for Zaps. The evidence is a single marketing line about Agents/Copilot and a narrow troubleshooting feature, so the depth of task delegation is unproven. The MCP material describes external AI clients such as Claude and ChatGPT calling Zapier, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: detailed docs on how users delegate tasks to the built-in Copilot/Agents (scope, autonomy, confirmation flow), evidence the assistant runs inside the Zapier UI rather than only through external clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.
Zapier will use AI to create troubleshooting instructions for you to review.
